description: This file defines two React functional components, KnightIcon and QueenIcon, which render SVG icons for a chess knight and queen respectively. The components support customization via className and accessibility features through role, aria-label, and optional titles. The components are designed for use in a React project, particularly within a component-based UI framework with styling conventions like Tailwind.

methods.name: KnightIcon
methods.description: A React component rendering an SVG icon of a chess knight, with customizable className and title for accessibility.

methods.name: QueenIcon
methods.description: A React component rendering an SVG icon of a chess queen, with customizable className and title for accessibility.
